name: samadhan-legacy-redirect
description: Samadhan was called Setu before v7 and lived at /apps/setu. This stub keeps every old link working (ticket deep links, CSAT survey links, the requester portal, bookmarks): it publishes tiny pages at /apps/setu/ and /apps/setu/portal/ that forward to the same place under /apps/samadhan/, keeping the query string and hash. No framework or dependencies; build.js writes dist/.
